# Gold Concentrator

> Ore-led mineral processing flowsheet review, gravity concentration testing and equipment coordination for practical 5-100 TPH projects.

Gold Concentrator focuses on alluvial gold and hard rock gold, with additional gravity separation work for tin, tungsten, chrome and other dense minerals. Equipment selection is presented as dependent on representative ore data, liberation size, capacity, water, power and site conditions.

## Evidence policy

- Published recovery or performance figures require supporting evidence and applicable conditions.
- Reference cases describe process logic and are not performance guarantees for another ore.
- Workshop media is identified as manufacturing evidence and is not presented as a customer project.
- A representative sample or reliable ore information may be required before final equipment selection.
